completedVerified: Existing local bootstrap exposes a startup-captured runtime content identity and opaque save/journal scope. Only matching code and scope can reuse a process; identical version labels alone are insufficient.

Actual launcher refuses older/unverifiable/different/malformed/unresponsive existing processes rather than silently reopening or starting another reader. The child rejects changed package bytes before journal creation. Matching custom journal directories remain reusable.

Herd cards and every herd-summary mode now share the same coverage-aware Diamond/Great One label function as Insights. Unknown is not zero; positive partial totals say known. Career awards, candidate counts and female capability remain separate.
Complete native, standalone Insights fixture and all nine local/all nine live workflows passed on exact source. Merge content equals tested runtime; both package builds have identical bytes/hash.
changedUnverified: Install-once signed automatic updates remain unfinished. This guard does not download, install, terminate or replace an old running process. Content fingerprints are not publisher signatures.

Owner Windows installation, actual owner game saves, physical phone/camera/gallery and independent manual visual acceptance were not exercised. No owner data, journal, enrollment or credentials were modified.

Separate screenshot intake work in PR11 was not changed or included. Previously reported updater source artifacts were not retrievable from current Project files this turn; they were not recovered, integrated or discarded.

Managed sign-in, account-owned cross-phone recovery, authorized automatic console capture, remaining game-save coverage, community/profile/media/game breadth and full Phase 1 acceptance retain their existing requirements. This release makes no new provider-auth status claim.
